323:t_1:34.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... Maybe these feelings of mine are my atonement to you...)

323:t_1:35.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Even so, I will live as I see fit. I have thrown away the $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ name, and my self as a $$ネクスタント$$.)

323:t_1:36.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I will live alongside $$キリコ$$... For as long as I have life, I will keep chasing him...)

323:t_1:40.en: ～ $$グルフェー$$ Chamber of Commerce Office ～

323:t_1:41.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「...Good work, $$ゼロ$$. I never thought you'd take out the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$ in a single night.」

323:t_1:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It was also the result of unexpected strokes of luck, like $$ヒイロ$$ and the others joining us. This much is hardly worth praise.」

323:t_1:43.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(He seems sore that $$キリコ$$ going off on his own kept him from using the tactic he had planned.)

323:t_1:44.en:
$$スザク$$
(Well, the pit trap we dug on the edge of town did go to waste.)

323:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But we even wiped out a $$マーティアル$$ unit, one with many believers in this town too...」

323:t_1:47.en:
$$バニラ$$
「There were no witnesses. I put it out that the $$マーティアル$$ squad that came to help ended up in a glorious mutual kill with the Brigade.」

323:t_1:49.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well... this was the way to settle things most quietly.」

323:t_1:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, it bothers me that $$マーティアル$$, whose authority collapsed after the 《$$赫い霍乱$$》 at $$アレギウム$$, is making a comeback.」

323:t_1:51.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「These are troubled times. Everyone wants something to cling to.」

323:t_1:52.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Not that I want $$マーティアル$$, driving people into fighting left and right.」

323:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Agreed. There is no need to put guns in the hands of people who should not fight.」

323:t_1:54.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Your payment is ready. Take it, $$ゼロ$$.」

323:t_1:55.en:
$$バニラ$$
「And, if I may add, I've got some work to line up for you guys.」

323:t_1:58.en:
$$レモン$$
「Nice to meet you. I'm $$ミシェル・レモン$$... A journalist, more or less. Barely, really.」

323:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You are asking us to take a job?」

323:t_1:60.en:
$$レモン$$
「Yes. I'd like your help investigating the organization lurking behind $$ナムサク$$.」

323:t_1:67.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Mr. $$レモン$$ said he had some business and went to $$グルフェー$$.」

323:t_1:69.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Anyway, $$宗介$$... I'm counting on you for today's match too.」

323:t_1:70.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Our team has ranked up to the point where we can aim for Class A with just a little more.」

323:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your fighting this time, $$キリコ$$, was peerless and ferocious as a lion.」

323:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The enemy soldiers, terrified by the exploits of the Untouchable, $$キリコ$$, produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

323:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize... That was an indelicate remark.」

323:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A difficult question. Philosophy, literature, religious studies, cultural anthropology, psychology... Answers come from all sorts of fields, but...」

323:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The god I imagine is not a being that helps me.」

323:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A god is one who wields power beyond human knowledge... In other words, they pay not the slightest heed to the existence of humans...」

323:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Surely they would bend our fates without a second thought to serve their own purposes.」

323:t_10:15.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I see... Sorry to have bothered you.」

323:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His contact with $$テイタニア$$ is probably fueling it.」

323:t_10:19.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Something is stirring... No... Perhaps it has already started to move...」

323:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am AG, the guide of the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

323:t_10:27.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I am $$テイタニア$$. Pleased to meet you.」

323:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are surprisingly frank. Most people are wary of my steel body.」

323:t_10:29.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Most of my own body is machine too.」

323:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I am aware. However, you do not seem to be equipped with the auxiliary brain that marks a $$ネクスタント$$.」

323:t_10:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「That was destroyed by $$キリコ$$ and left that way.」

323:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to stay close to your body as your auxiliary brain.」

323:t_10:33.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...Do you want to die?」

323:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Heavens, no! I merely meant to carry out the ritual welcoming you into our ranks!」

323:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all again today...」

323:t_10:41.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「W-what... Just saying these few words fills me with indescribable humiliation...」

323:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is a ritual, so please pay it no mind. Now, next...」

323:t_10:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「I heard $$テイタニア$$ headed for the hangar, so I came to look, and sure enough!」

323:t_10:46.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Sorry, $$カレン$$. I'm causing you trouble.」

323:t_10:47.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm only doing this because I want to.」

323:t_10:48.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...Why do you look out for me?」

323:t_10:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「Maybe because I found one small thing about you that's like me...」

323:t_10:51.en:
$$カレン$$
「So lean on me a little, okay? If there's anything I can do, I'll help.」

323:t_10:52.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...Sorry. I'll take you up on that kindness.」
